sn17.5:1.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, mīḷhakā gūthādī, gūthapūrā, puṇṇā gūthassa, purato cassa mahāgūthapuñjo.
sn17.5:1.5: ahaṃ hi gūthādī, gūthapūrā, puṇṇā gūthassa, purato ca myāyaṃ mahāgūthapuñjoti.
sn17.5:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.
sn17.5:1.7: so tattha bhuttāvī ca hoti yāvadattho, nimantito ca svātanāya, piṇḍapāto cassa pūro.
sn17.5:1.8: so ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhugaṇassa majjhe vikatthati:
sn17.5:1.9: bhuttāvī camhi yāvadattho, nimantitocamhi svātanāya, piṇḍapāto ca myāyaṃ pūro, lābhī camhi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ. ime panaññe bhikkhū appapuññā appesakkhā na lābhino cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
sn17.5:1.10: so tena lābhasakkārasilokenābhibhibhūto pariyādinnacitto aññepesale bhikkhū atimaññati.
sn17.5:1.11: taṃ hi tassa bhikkhave, moghapurisassa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
sn17.5:1.13: [uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma …pe…] evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave, sikkhitabbanti.
